title: One Command Turns Any PC or Mac Into a Full Private AI Server (100% Free)
description:
Someone just built a one-command install that gives you a complete private AI server on your own machine — no cloud, no subscription, and nothing ever leaves your computer.

It's called ODS and it's completely free.

Here's what one command gets you in about 2 minutes:

🤖 Local LLM — Auto-detects your GPU and downloads the right model for your hardware automatically

💬 ChatGPT-style Web UI — With voice input and output built in

⚙️ Autonomous Agents + n8n Workflows — 400+ integrations, all wired up out of the box

🔍 Private Web Search — No tracking. No logging.

🎨 ComfyUI for Image Generation — All talking to each other from day one

Works on Nvidia, AMD, and Apple Silicon. There's even a bootstrap mode that gets you chatting in under 2 minutes while the full model downloads in the background.

Every prompt you ever send stays on your machine. Forever.

Comment "Local" and I'll send you the link 👇

#LocalAI #PrivateAI #ODS #AITools #RunAILocally #NoCloud #OpenSourceAI #N8n #ComfyUI #AIForDevelopers #SelfHostedAI #LLM #AIPrivacy #FreeAI #Shorts
